title: Модный показ и платье для Елены  (The Fashion Show and a Dress for Elena)

scenes.title: Preparing for the Fashion Show
scenes.summary: Eleonora instructs Mikhail to prepare the hotel for a Swedish fashion designer's show, and Nastya gets jealous of the models around Kostya.

scenes.title: Dream of a Wedding Dress
scenes.summary: Elena says she would marry Chef Barinov in one of Gustavson's dresses, so Chef Barinov approaches the designer to buy one.

scenes.title: Concert in the Kremlin
scenes.summary: Told that the designer only dresses stars, Chef Barinov claims that his fiancée Elena is a famous singer performing at the Kremlin.

scenes.title: The Superstar and the Salad
scenes.summary: The translator confirms the singer's fame, Katya asks Denis to keep a safe distance, and a hungry model approaches the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Models' Strict Diet
scenes.summary: A starving model eats a steak in the kitchen, and Senya and Fedya agree to sneak meals to her room before the show.

scenes.title: Kostya's Night Shift
scenes.summary: Kostya agrees to cover the night shift at the bar for a coworker, and a suspicious Nastya warns him to behave.

scenes.title: Secret Dinner to the Room
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya bring a secret steak to the model's room, while Chef Barinov introduces Olaf to Elena from afar.

scenes.title: Invitation to a Fitting
scenes.summary: Olaf asks when Elena can come for a fitting, and Chef Barinov claims she is too busy with concerts and filming.

scenes.title: Louis Behind the Bar
scenes.summary: Kostya asks Louis to watch the bar while he uses the restroom, and Louis unexpectedly hits it off with the model Polina.

scenes.title: The Missing Tunic and Rumors
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov sneaks Elena's tunic out of the house, Mikhail catches Senya and Fedya stealing steaks, and Polina gossips about the bartender.

scenes.title: Nastya's Accusation
scenes.summary: Nastya accuses Kostya of cheating on her with a model during his night shift, and refuses to believe that it was actually Louis.

scenes.title: A Dress to Size
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov hands Elena's old tunic to Olaf for sizing, claiming it is a sentimental dress from her early days as a poor singer.

scenes.title: Louis's Confession
scenes.summary: Louis returns to the kitchen thrilled after his night with Polina and asks Kostya for champagne to take back to her room.

scenes.title: Room Delivery
scenes.summary: Kostya heads to room 202 to film Louis with Polina, while Senya and Fedya finish feeding their hungry model.

scenes.title: The Magazine Trick
scenes.summary: The model fulfills her promise by showing Senya and Fedya a magazine photo of herself, then kicks them out of her room.

scenes.title: Video in the Room and Nastya's Dad
scenes.summary: Kostya's attempt to film proof in room 202 backfires when Polina kisses him in the dark, while Nastya's angry father arrives.

scenes.title: Uninvited Guests at the Show
scenes.summary: Elena unexpectedly arrives at the fashion show with a press pass, while Nastya's father corners Kostya in room 202.

scenes.title: Showdown in the Room
scenes.summary: Louis steps out of the hotel bathroom in a robe and confirms to Nastya and her father that Polina is with him, clearing Kostya.

scenes.title: The Fashion Show Finale
scenes.summary: Olaf calls Chef Barinov and Elena onto the stage to gift her the designer dress, but insists that she sing a song for the crowd.

scenes.title: The Michelin Inspector
scenes.summary: Elena thanks Chef Barinov for her dream wedding dress, and a Michelin inspector unexpectedly arrives in the kitchen.
